name: Black-bean beef stir-fry
steps: Marinate the sliced beef in half the soy sauce for twenty minutes.
Sear the beef in a hot oiled wok until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry the onion and green pepper for two minutes.
Mash in the black beans with the remaining soy sauce and return the beef.
Toss until glossy and serve over the cooked rice.
